posts.name: arenson9
posts.cooked:
grim88:

"Reveal the top card of a deck and put into play or trash."? 

 

Revealing cards is specifically not the same as drawing cards, so yes you can reveal cards even when you are not allowed to draw cards. Conversely, if you have no cards in your deck, you will have nothing to reveal and you will not cause the trash to be shuffled back into the deck.

It's a great combo.

posts.name: Ameena
posts.cooked: To add to the Nemesis comments, another way to tell is to check for a Nemesis symbol - if one target attacks another target and both have the same symbol, the Nemesis bonus applies. Doesn't count for a target hitting itself, though. Also, note that it's not just villains who have Nemesis symbols - Anubis has Ra's symbol, and Rat Beasts have Chrono Ranger's. Finally, the Ennead all have Ra's symbol, and the Nemesis bonus will apply if something causes them to hit each other (eg someone redirecting their damage) - just because they're working together doesn't mean they like each other ;).

One (hopefully) last question.

Wagnar Mars Base... Fire in the Biosphere: "...Deals each Target 2 fire damage. Each Hero must either destroy 1 of their Ongoing Cards or take 2 more Fire damage."
 

I assume if I have no Ongoing cards to destroy, I must take the additional damage?

Same rule would apply for any card that says "destroy/discard x cards or take x damage"?

I know that if the above situation said "discard your hand" and you have no cards in your hand you're safe, but what if it mentions a specific number of cards and you have none?

Thanks again...

posts.cooked: If you are unable to discard or destroy the required card, you will take the punishment for not doing so. So if you had no ongoings for Fire in the Biosphere, you will take the additonal 2 damage.
